children: Lokotech AS said the first silicon wafers for its Scrypt ASIC and Edge AI inferencing chip have finished processing at the foundry and are out of fab. The wafers now proceed to packaging, bring-up, tests and verification.
De-risks the ASIC program by moving from design to silicon, a key milestone.
Covers both Scrypt ASIC and Edge AI chip, broadening potential revenue paths.
Near-term results from bring-up/validation could drive sentiment.
No performance data yet; stock may wait for measurable benchmarks.

This is an early-stage execution milestone, moving from taped-out design to first silicon for mining and AI chips. A larger catalyst requires successful bring-up with verified performance and efficiency metrics, followed by clear commercialization steps.
